apps.localizedDescription:
What if fishing could take you into a world of ancient secrets, lost monsters, and mysterious treasures beneath the waves?
Welcome to Creatures of the Deep+ - the most unique single-player fishing adventure on mobile.

Strange rumors are spreading across the globe. Disturbing shadows move under the water. Legends come to life - and you’re at the center of it all.
Dive into the ultimate mix of relaxation, exploration, and mystery.

FEATURES

Explore breathtaking fishing locations - from paradise islands to haunted lakes and toxic wastelands.

Catch 600+ species of fish, creatures, treasures... and legendary monsters.

Discover hidden stories, lost relics, and NPCs full of personality.
